panels.title: Top switching flows (x → y)
panels.description: Someone switched from x to y, in the selected channels and time range: 'switched from Notion to Obsidian', 'dropped ChatGPT for Claude', 'we replaced our Jira with Linear', 'the Jenkins to GitHub Actions migration'. mentions: comments and posts (each counts once), authors: different people. the other way: the mentions of y → x, who is winning. per_10k: per 10,000 comments and posts. Click a flow for the comments behind it (last 48 hours) or the term explorer.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
    (SELECT sum(docs) FROM scope_hourly WHERE channel IN (SELECT channel FROM channel_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT channel FROM channels WHERE channel = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(channel IN (${channel:singlequote}), $channel) AND $__conditionalAll(doc_type IN (${doc_type:singlequote}), $doc_type) AND hour >= toDateTime(toDate($__fromTime), 'UTC') AND hour < toDateTime(toDate($__toTime) + 1, 'UTC')) AS total,
    flows AS (
        SELECT term, sum(docs) AS mentions, uniqCombinedMerge(12)(authors) AS authors
        FROM term_daily
        WHERE channel IN (SELECT channel FROM channel_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT channel FROM channels WHERE channel = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(channel IN (${channel:singlequote}), $channel) AND $__conditionalAll(doc_type IN (${doc_type:singlequote}), $doc_type) AND kind = 'switch' AND day >= toDate($__fromTime) AND day <= toDate($__toTime)
        GROUP BY term
    )
SELECT
    splitByString(' → ', f.term)[1] AS from,
    splitByString(' → ', f.term)[2] AS to,
    f.mentions AS mentions,
    f.authors AS authors,
    r.mentions AS `the other way`,
    round(10000 * f.mentions / total, 2) AS per_10k,
    f.term AS term,
    concat('/d/undercurrent-intents?var-term=', encodeURLFormComponent(term), '&var-group=', encodeURLFormComponent(${group:sqlstring}), '&from=now-30d&to=now') AS examples, concat('/d/undercurrent-terms?var-terms=', encodeURLFormComponent(term), '&var-group=', encodeURLFormComponent(${group:sqlstring}), '&var-bucket=day&from=now-90d&to=now') AS explore
FROM flows AS f
LEFT JOIN flows AS r
    ON r.term = concat(splitByString(' → ', f.term)[2], ' → ', splitByString(' → ', f.term)[1])
WHERE f.authors >= ${min_authors:raw}
ORDER BY mentions DESC, authors DESC, from
LIMIT 50

SELECT toDateTime(day, 'UTC') AS time, term, sum(docs) AS mentions
FROM term_daily
WHERE channel IN (SELECT channel FROM channel_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT channel FROM channels WHERE channel = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(channel IN (${channel:singlequote}), $channel) AND $__conditionalAll(doc_type IN (${doc_type:singlequote}), $doc_type) AND kind = 'switch' AND day >= toDate($__fromTime) AND day <= toDate($__toTime)
GROUP BY time, term
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Rising: alternatives sought
panels.description: Alternatives people look for or use instead: 'alternatives to LastPass', 'a good Plex alternative', 'I use Firefox instead of Chrome', 'moving away from AWS'. The last 7 days (today included) against the 28 days before, in the selected channels; ignores the time picker. mentions, authors: the last 7 days. per_week_before: the weekly average of the 28 days before. times_usual: the share of comments and posts now against before. excess: mentions above what the share before would give, what the table is sorted by. trend_z: the strongest score of the short-term detector in the last 24 hours, if it trends in the group or one of its channels. per day: the last 35 days. Click an entry for the comments behind it.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
    (SELECT sum(docs) FROM scope_hourly
     WHERE channel IN (SELECT channel FROM channel_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT channel FROM channels WHERE channel = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(channel IN (${channel:singlequote}), $channel) AND $__conditionalAll(doc_type IN (${doc_type:singlequote}), $doc_type) AND hour >= toDateTime(today() - 6, 'UTC')) AS n_now,
    (SELECT sum(docs) FROM scope_hourly
     WHERE channel IN (SELECT channel FROM channel_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT channel FROM channels WHERE channel = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(channel IN (${channel:singlequote}), $channel) AND $__conditionalAll(doc_type IN (${doc_type:singlequote}), $doc_type) AND hour >= toDateTime(today() - 34, 'UTC')
       AND hour < toDateTime(today() - 6, 'UTC')) AS n_before,
    trending AS (
        SELECT term, max(z) AS z FROM trends
        WHERE detected_at > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND kind = 'alternative' AND subsumed_by = ''
          AND scope IN (SELECT ${group:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT channel FROM channel_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT channel FROM channels WHERE channel = ${group:sqlstring})
        GROUP BY term
    )
SELECT
    if(position(term, ': ') > 0, substring(term, position(term, ': ') + 2), term) AS entity,
    sumIf(docs, day >= today() - 6) AS mentions,
    uniqCombinedMergeIf(12)(authors, day >= today() - 6) AS authors,
    round(sumIf(docs, day < today() - 6) / 4, 1) AS per_week_before,
    -- the share now against the share before, with half a mention added to both
    round((mentions + 0.5) / n_now / ((sumIf(docs, day < today() - 6) + 0.5)
          / greatest(n_before, 1)), 1) AS times_usual,
    round(mentions - sumIf(docs, day < today() - 6) * n_now / greatest(n_before, 1), 1)
        AS excess,
    round(any(t.z), 1) AS trend_z,
    term,
    concat('/d/undercurrent-intents?var-term=', encodeURLFormComponent(term), '&var-group=', encodeURLFormComponent(${group:sqlstring}), '&from=now-30d&to=now') AS examples, concat('/d/undercurrent-terms?var-terms=', encodeURLFormComponent(term), '&var-group=', encodeURLFormComponent(${group:sqlstring}), '&var-bucket=day&from=now-90d&to=now') AS explore
FROM term_daily
LEFT JOIN trending AS t USING term
WHERE channel IN (SELECT channel FROM channel_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT channel FROM channels WHERE channel = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(channel IN (${channel:singlequote}), $channel) AND $__conditionalAll(doc_type IN (${doc_type:singlequote}), $doc_type) AND kind = 'alternative' AND day >= today() - 34
GROUP BY term
HAVING mentions >= ${min_mentions:raw} AND authors >= ${min_authors:raw}
ORDER BY excess DESC, mentions DESC
LIMIT 30

SELECT toDateTime(day, 'UTC') AS time, term, sum(docs) AS mentions
FROM term_daily
WHERE channel IN (SELECT channel FROM channel_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT channel FROM channels WHERE channel = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(channel IN (${channel:singlequote}), $channel) AND $__conditionalAll(doc_type IN (${doc_type:singlequote}), $doc_type) AND kind = 'alternative' AND day >= today() - 34

panels.title: Top unmet needs per group
panels.description: The 10 needs mentioned most in each configured group (and the r/all sample) in the time range: 'is there an app to …', 'I wish there was a way to …', 'I'd pay for an app that …', 'does anyone know a tool for …'. A need is the 2–3 words after it ('track my sleep'). Ignores the group picker. Click a need for its comments.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    g.group_name AS group,
    substring(t.term, 7) AS need,
    sum(t.docs) AS mentions,
    uniqCombinedMerge(12)(t.authors) AS authors,
    t.term AS term,
    concat('/d/undercurrent-intents?var-term=', encodeURLFormComponent(term), '&var-group=', encodeURLFormComponent(group), '&from=now-30d&to=now') AS examples, concat('/d/undercurrent-terms?var-terms=', encodeURLFormComponent(term), '&var-group=', encodeURLFormComponent(group), '&var-bucket=day&from=now-90d&to=now') AS explore
FROM term_daily AS t
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT group_name, channel FROM channel_groups
    WHERE group_name NOT IN (SELECT platform FROM channels)
    UNION ALL SELECT channel, channel FROM channels WHERE background
) AS g ON g.channel = t.channel
WHERE t.kind = 'need' AND t.day >= toDate($__fromTime) AND t.day <= toDate($__toTime)
  AND $__conditionalAll(t.doc_type IN (${doc_type:singlequote}), $doc_type)
GROUP BY group, term
HAVING authors >= ${min_authors:raw}
ORDER BY group, mentions DESC, authors DESC, need
LIMIT 10 BY group

panels.title: Comments behind intents, last 48 hours
panels.description: The comments and posts the intents were found in, newest first. Raw text is only kept for 48 hours. Set Term (or click an entry in the tables above) to see one intent's comments, e.g. 'notion → obsidian' or 'complaint: reddit'; empty shows all of the selected kinds.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    created_at AS time,
    channel,
    arrayStringConcat(arrayFilter(t -> if(position(t, ': ') > 0, splitByString(': ', t)[1], 'switch') IN (${intent_kind:singlequote})
                                       AND (${term:sqlstring} = '' OR t = ${term:sqlstring}),
                                  intents), ', ') AS found,
    substring(text, 1, 500) AS text,
    url AS link
FROM items
WHERE channel IN (SELECT channel FROM channel_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT channel FROM channels WHERE channel = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(channel IN (${channel:singlequote}), $channel) AND $__conditionalAll(doc_type IN (${doc_type:singlequote}), $doc_type) AND created_at > now() - INTERVAL 48 HOUR
  AND arrayExists(t -> if(position(t, ': ') > 0, splitByString(': ', t)[1], 'switch') IN (${intent_kind:singlequote})
                       AND (${term:sqlstring} = '' OR t = ${term:sqlstring}), intents)
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 200

panels.title: Intents per day
panels.description: Comments and posts with an intent per day, by kind.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(day, 'UTC') AS time, kind, sum(docs) AS mentions
FROM term_daily
WHERE channel IN (SELECT channel FROM channel_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring} UNION ALL SELECT channel FROM channels WHERE channel = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(channel IN (${channel:singlequote}), $channel) AND $__conditionalAll(doc_type IN (${doc_type:singlequote}), $doc_type) AND kind IN ('switch', 'alternative', 'complaint', 'need', 'considering') AND day >= toDate($__fromTime) AND day <= toDate($__toTime)
GROUP BY time, kind
ORDER BY time
